title: Doctor Quadpaw
subtitle: Rebel
description: Known to most as Doctor Quadpaw, the surgeon worked out of an operating theater on the world of Frezno. he was the sort of doctor who helped people who couldn't go to a regular facility for medical care. He had cybernetic enhancements for vision and audio processors that aided his four arms in performing surgery on those desperate enough to pay him. For Karis Nemik, Quadpaw's help came too late.
